ticket.subject: Can't log in
ticket.body: Hi, I've been trying to log into my account all morning and it keeps saying my password is wrong. I haven't changed it. Can you help?

agent.draft_reply:
Dear Daniel,

Thank you for getting in touch. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble logging into your account.

If you can't log in, the quickest way to regain access is to use the **Forgot password** link on the login page. A reset link will be sent to the email address on your account (daniel.hughes@example.com) and is valid for 60 minutes. Please check your spam or junk folder in case the email has been filtered there.

Please note that after 5 failed login attempts, your account is locked for 30 minutes as a security measure, so if you've had several attempts this morning, you may need to wait a little while before trying again.

If the email address on your account is out of date or you continue to have difficulty, please reply to this email and we'll be happy to help verify your identity and reset your password manually.

For your security, please remember that Member Services will never ask you for your password.

Kind regards,
Northbank FC Member Services

ticket.subject: Away ballot points
ticket.body: How do loyalty points work for the away ballot? Do I get points for cup games?

agent.draft_reply:
Dear Chris,

Thank you for your enquiry about loyalty points and the away ballot.

I'm pleased to confirm that you currently have 246 loyalty points on your Gold membership account (NB100114). You earn loyalty points as follows: 1 point for each home league match you attend, and 2 points for each away league match you attend. These points are used to rank applications in our away match ballots, with higher balances receiving priority in the draw.

Regarding cup games, our loyalty points policy does not cover cup competitions. Cup ballot rules are published separately for each competition, so I'd recommend checking the relevant cup competition announcement when fixtures are announced to understand how that specific ballot will work.

You can view your current loyalty points balance at any time by logging into My Account and selecting Loyalty. If you have any further questions about how your points affect your away ballot standing, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Kind regards,
Northbank FC Member Services
agent.rationale: Chris is a matched Gold member enquiring about how loyalty points work for the away ballot and whether cup games earn points. We provide his current balance (246 points) and explain the league match earning rules; we also clarify that cup competitions are not covered by this policy and direct him to per-competition guidance.
